syncSurface.description: Refresh individual primitives here from the canonical ui.shadcn.com registry. These mirror upstream and are meant to be customized in place.
syncSurface.safeCommand: npx shadcn add <component-name>   # one primitive, then diff & re-apply any VFIC patch
syncSurface.forbiddenCommand: npx shadcn add https://marmelab.com/atomic-crm/r/atomic-crm.json -o   # overwrites every locked path above

precommit.note: `make registry-gen` regenerates frontend/registry.json additively from file globs. It is safe but always review the diff — it should only ever ADD entries, never drop VFIC files.
